algorithms.label: Wallace rule
algorithms.applicability: Rough base-count estimate. Concentrations, salt and self-complementarity are not used.

algorithms.label: GC empirical
algorithms.description: DNA GC formula; additive salt corrections only. Oligo concentration is not used.
algorithms.applicability: DNA empirical estimate. Oligo concentrations and self-complementarity are not used.

algorithms.label: Nearest-neighbor: Breslauer 1986
algorithms.applicability: Perfect DNA duplex unless an explicit 3′→5′ complementary strand is supplied in Advanced duplex Tm.

algorithms.label: Nearest-neighbor: Sugimoto 1996
algorithms.description: DNA/DNA nearest-neighbor parameters from Sugimoto et al.
algorithms.applicability: Perfect DNA duplex unless an explicit 3′→5′ complementary strand is supplied in Advanced duplex Tm.

algorithms.label: Nearest-neighbor: Allawi & SantaLucia 1997
algorithms.description: DNA/DNA nearest-neighbor table used as Biopython's default NN parameter set.
algorithms.applicability: Perfect DNA duplex unless an explicit 3′→5′ complementary strand is supplied in Advanced duplex Tm.

algorithms.label: Nearest-neighbor: SantaLucia & Hicks 2004
algorithms.applicability: Perfect DNA duplex unless an explicit 3′→5′ complementary strand is supplied in Advanced duplex Tm.

algorithms.label: RNA/RNA NN: Freier 1986
algorithms.applicability: RNA reference condition: 1 M Na. Only perfectly paired overlap is supported; RNA/RNA dangling ends use RNA_DE1. No DNA salt extrapolation.

algorithms.label: RNA/RNA NN: Xia 1998
algorithms.description: RNA/RNA nearest-neighbor parameters from Xia et al.
algorithms.applicability: RNA reference condition: 1 M Na. Only perfectly paired overlap is supported; RNA/RNA dangling ends use RNA_DE1. No DNA salt extrapolation.

algorithms.label: RNA/RNA NN: Chen 2012
algorithms.applicability: RNA reference condition: 1 M Na. Only perfectly paired overlap is supported; RNA/RNA dangling ends use RNA_DE1. No DNA salt extrapolation.

algorithms.label: RNA/DNA hybrid NN: Sugimoto 1995
algorithms.description: RNA/DNA hybrid nearest-neighbor table. Sequence must be RNA.
algorithms.applicability: RNA reference condition: 1 M Na. Only perfectly paired overlap is supported; RNA/RNA dangling ends use RNA_DE1. No DNA salt extrapolation.

salt_corrections.label: Wetmur 1991
salt_corrections.description: Monovalent salt correction using the Wetmur formulation.

salt_corrections.label: SantaLucia 1996
salt_corrections.description: Monovalent salt correction from SantaLucia et al. 1996.

salt_corrections.label: SantaLucia 1998 (Tm)
salt_corrections.description: SantaLucia 1998 salt correction applied directly to Tm.

salt_corrections.label: SantaLucia 1998 (entropy)
salt_corrections.description: SantaLucia 1998 entropy correction. Good general-purpose PCR default.

salt_corrections.label: Owczarzy 2008
salt_corrections.description: Mg2+/dNTP-aware salt correction for mixed monovalent/divalent PCR conditions.
